title: Testing the Impact of the MOHR Follow-up Support
official: Testing the Impact of the My Own Health Report Intervention With 3 Distinct Options for Structured Follow-up as Compared to a Control Condition
summary: This study will evaluate the impact of 3 different strategies to increase engagement of participants in My Own Health Report (MOHR) and health behavior change activities over time. This study will evaluate the level of engagement, outcomes, cost and cost-effectiveness of these strategies.

interventions.name: Providing reminder and resources via messages
Reminder and resources sent via navigation

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults, aged 18 years and older.
* Completion of the MOHR health risk assessment and goal-setting tool
* Score as medium risk or high risk in any of the following risk areas from MOHR tool: 1) fruit and vegetable intake; 2) sugar-sweetened beverages; 3) fast food; 4) physical activity; 5) stress; and 6) sleep
* Patient at one of the participating clinics

Exclusion Criteria:

* Incomplete or no MOHR assessment
* Language preference/proficiency other than English or Spanish
* Presence of a condition(s) or diagnosis, either physical or psychological, or physical exam finding that precludes participation. Examples include - Indices of advanced illness and frailty, such as dementia (ICD-10 codes F01.50, F01.51, F02.80, F02.81, F03.90, F03.91, F10.27, F10.97, G31.09, G31.83 or dementia medication of Donepezil • Galantamine • Rivastigmine, Memantine, or Donepezil-memantine)).
